questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Consider that there are a lot of Danish students as well. It's a very nice experience if that is what you're looking for. Also, it is crazy expensive - so be sure you have some savings. Otherwise, make sure to not use all of your money at the beginning of the semester.
